title: A multi-agent, multi-session project database
why: Covers the surfaces that only exist once a `.ctrace` holds more than one run: the `sessions` listing (labels, local-time rendering, per-session agent lists), the `agents` rollup across sessions, per-agent token attribution, cross-agent cache analysis (a hand-off must never be counted as a prefix break), and a developer-tagged `rag` block whose label comes from `basic_label`'s tag path rather than its role. Session 2 injects a live clock into the system block, which is the classic prefix-break misconfiguration.
